content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple has designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use them. You can download them below right now.

Download iPhone 18 Pro new wallpapers

While the default iOS wallpapers are dynamic images that change with device movement and interaction, the versions below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 Release Candidate.

The Release Candidate doesn't appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so we'll probably have to wait a few weeks, or until iOS 27.1, to get it.

Remember to tap on the image to save the full-resolution wallpaper. If you're on an iOS device, you can then set it as your background via the Photos app or the Settings app.

For 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, click this link.

Which one is your favorite? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
